description.subtitle: Real Madrid 2025 2026 Adidas Women's Pre-Match Warm-Up Shirt - Blue
description.tagline: Unique style to shine before kick-off
description.intro: The Real Madrid pre-match t-shirt for women is perfect for showing your support with a modern design inspired by the Bernabéu. Its comfortable fit and technical fabric accompany you both in the warm-up and in the stands.
key_benefits: Impactful design: Dynamic graphic that reflects the style of the Bernabeu.
Guaranteed comfort: Soft and light fabric for daily or sports use.
Always dry skin: AEROREADY technology that absorbs sweat.
Embroidered Shield: Premium detail that shows your white passion.
Total versatility: Ideal for training, cheering or dressing with style.
